title: Classic Daiquiri
description: White rum and fresh lime shaken with simple syrup.
steps: Fill a shaker with ice. Add 2 fluid ounces white rum, 1 fluid ounce lime juice, and ¾ fluid ounce simple syrup.
Shake for about 12 seconds and strain into a chilled coupe.
imageAlt: Pale lime daiquiri in a stemmed coupe with a cut lime nearby
